title: TAG package extension (plugin.json extensions["com.theapotheosisgroup.tag-skills"])
description: TAG's client-owned data in an Agent Plugins 1.0.0 manifest: which skills the package ships, the lowest plan tier each belongs to, and, for an agent package, its agent-instructions skill. Tiers are cumulative: foundation < structure < turnkey. It grants no access: entitlement is aletia's check.

agent.description: Set only for an agent package: the agent-instructions skill, one of the package's own skills. An agent package bundles every skill its skills depend on, so it loads on its own.

tier.description: The lowest plan tier that includes the skill; every higher tier includes it too.

from.description: Set when an agent package bundles a skill whose home is another package: that package's name. Absent for the package's own skills.
